title: Architecture Exploration
description: Explore how SiteFlow UI implementation should map to application architecture. Use brainstorm context, feature-index, design-ref, and prototypes. Identify module boundaries, route structure, state/data contracts, and source-of-truth artifacts.
findings: 架构结论：当前仓库基本只有 .workflow 设计/规划产物，UI 规划应以 design-ref 为 source of truth。建议共享 app shell + 路由：/projects、/projects/:id、/deployments/:id、/projects/:id/release/:channel、/projects/:id/rollback/:channel。状态以 DB 控制面为唯一真源，沿 source_event→build_job→artifact→deployment→release_channel/preview→route_revision/audit_event 取数；artifact backend 只拥有 bytes。

title: Implementation Exploration
description: Explore implementation approach and conventions for converting the design reference into a real frontend. Since codebase is empty or minimal, infer stack-neutral patterns, component boundaries, token usage, and realistic file targets from artifacts.
findings: Repo has no implementation baseline beyond .workflow artifacts. Plan should scaffold a TS React/Vite operator console from design-ref: shared shell, panels, tables, status pills, timelines, log/lineage evidence, release safety checks, audit reason forms. Use design/animation tokens as source of truth, fixture-backed API boundary first, then Vitest + Playwright responsive checks.

title: Integration Exploration
description: Explore integration points between UI, control-plane API, deployment state, artifact metadata, routing status, and release/rollback workflows. Map API contracts and state flows needed by each target page.
findings: Mapped UI integration contracts: project list/detail, deployment detail, and release/rollback need DB-backed read models for channels, deployments, artifacts, route revisions, logs, and audit. Canonical flow: webhook -> job -> artifact manifest -> deployment -> channel/preview -> route revision -> CDN. Added polling/SSE boundaries plus loading/error/empty states; appended 6 JSONL discoveries.

title: Risk Exploration
description: Explore execution risks: accessibility, responsive density, destructive rollback UX, stale deployment state, secrets exposure, route reload ambiguity, testing gaps, and plan collision risks.
findings: Identified key risks: critical secret/payload/log/manifest leakage; high-risk promote/rollback safeguards; stale deployment/route/CDN state and ambiguous Nginx reload side effects; rollback target retention/verification gaps; dense responsive/a11y issues; missing test scaffold; plan collisions in empty non-git repo. Appended 8 risk_factor discoveries; NDJSON validated (24 lines).

title: Plan Generation
description: Consume all exploration findings plus brainstorm and design-ref artifacts. Generate plan.json in .workflow/scratch/ui-design-siteflow-20260515 and TASK-*.json files in .workflow/scratch/ui-design-siteflow-20260515/.task. Use feature-level grouping, concrete read_first entries, convergence criteria, dependencies, estimates, and confidence scoring.
findings: Generated plan.json and TASK-001 through TASK-006. Plan uses 4 waves: scaffold/tokens/shell, API fixture contracts, parallel project/deployment/release views, then verification hardening. JSON parsed successfully; all tasks include ownership, read_first, actions, tests, convergence criteria, dependencies, and estimates. Readiness gate passes.
